map.📝 体质（平和/气虚/阳虚等）自测: 📝 Constitution (Balanced / Qi Deficiency / Yang Deficiency etc.) Self-Test
map.依据《中医体质分类与判定》(ZYYXH/T 157-2009)标准，通过9类体质: Identify your TCM constitution type through a nine-constitution questionnaire based on the ZYYXH/T 157-2009 standard Classification and Determination of TCM Body Constitution
map.平和质：您精力充沛吗？: Balanced constitution: do you have abundant energy?
map.平和质：您容易疲乏吗？（反向）: Balanced constitution: do you easily tire? (reverse)
map.气虚质：您容易气短、呼吸短促吗？: Qi deficiency constitution: do you often have shortness of breath or rapid breathing?
map.气虚质：您容易心慌吗？: Qi deficiency constitution: do you often feel anxious or palpitations?
map.阳虚质：您手脚发凉吗？: Yang deficiency constitution: do your hands and feet feel cold?
map.阳虚质：您胃脘部、背部或腰膝怕冷吗？: Yang deficiency constitution: do you feel cold in the epigastrium, back or lower back and knees?
map.阴虚质：您感到手脚心发热吗？: Yin deficiency constitution: do you feel heat in your palms and soles?
map.阴虚质：您口唇干燥吗？: Yin deficiency constitution: do you have dry lips?
map.痰湿质：您面部或鼻部有油腻感吗？: Phlegm-dampness constitution: do you have a greasy sensation in your face or nose?
map.痰湿质：您舌苔厚腻吗？: Phlegm-dampness constitution: is your tongue coating thick and greasy?
map.湿热质：您面部易生痤疮吗？: Damp-heat constitution: do you easily get acne on your face?
map.湿热质：您口苦或嘴里有异味吗？: Damp-heat constitution: do you have bitter taste or an unpleasant taste in your mouth?
map.血瘀质：您皮肤有瘀斑或口唇颜色偏暗吗？: Blood stasis constitution: do you have bruises on your skin or darker than usual lips?
map.血瘀质：您有黑眼圈吗？: Blood stasis constitution: do you have dark circles?
map.气郁质：您感到闷闷不乐、情绪低落吗？: Qi stagnation constitution: do you feel downcast and low in mood?
map.气郁质：您容易紧张焦虑吗？: Qi stagnation constitution: do you easily feel nervous or anxious?
map.特禀质：您容易过敏（药物/食物/花粉）吗？: Inherent constitution: do you easily develop allergies (medication/food/pollen)?
map.特禀质：您皮肤容易起荨麻疹吗？: Inherent constitution: does your skin easily develop urticaria?
map.关于「体质（平和/气虚/阳虚等）自测」: About "Constitution (Balanced / Qi Deficiency / Yang Deficiency etc.) Self-Test"
map.依据《中医体质分类与判定》(ZYYXH/T 157-2009)标准，通过9类体质: Identify your TCM constitution type through a standardised nine-constitution questionnaire based on the ZYYXH/T 157-2009 standard Classification and Determination of TCM Body Constitution, with constitution conditioning advice.
map.9 类各算分，取 judge=「是」中 score 最高者为主质；如气虚 72、: All 9 types are scored, and the one with the highest score among those judged "yes" becomes the primary constitution; for example qi deficiency 72 and yang deficiency 55 give a primary report of "qi deficiency constitution" with the rest listed as deviations.
map.9 类均「否」→提示「平和质倾向是/是」，颜色转绿，属健康基准态。: When all 9 types are "no" it indicates "tendency to balanced constitution / yes", the colour turns green, and this is the healthy baseline state.
map.和体质自测器关系？: How does it relate to the constitution self-test tool?
map.同九质体系，本版偏判定报告（主质＋偏颇列表），自测器偏逐题录入。: It uses the same nine-constitution system, but this version focuses on the determination report (primary constitution plus a list of deviations), whereas the self-test tool focuses on question-by-question entry.
map.能当诊断吗？: Can it serve as a diagnosis?
map.仅为科普自评，正式体质辨识请由执业中医师四诊合参。: It is a self-assessment for education only; formal constitution identification requires a licensed TCM practitioner combining all four diagnostic methods.
map.体质分类依据ZYYXH/T 157-2009《中医体质分类与判定》标准: The constitution classification follows the ZYYXH/T 157-2009 standard Classification and Determination of TCM Body Constitution
map.9种体质：平和质、气虚质、阳虚质、阴虚质、痰湿质、湿热质、血瘀质、气郁质、特禀质: The nine constitutions: balanced, qi deficiency, yang deficiency, yin deficiency, phlegm-dampness, damp-heat, blood stasis, qi stagnation and inherent
map.判定标准：转化分≥60分判定为\"是\"，40-59分为\"倾向是\"，＜40分: Determination standard: a conversion score of 60 or above is judged "yes", 40-59 is "tendency yes", and below 40 is "no"
map.平和质为正常体质，其余8种为偏颇体质: The balanced constitution is the normal constitution; the other 8 are deviation constitutions
map.体质可兼夹，建议在中医师指导下进行体质辨识和调养: Constitutions can overlap, so constitution identification and conditioning are best done under the guidance of a TCM practitioner
